review.scientific: Internal review: DAMP/HAMP, GLR and calcium, canonical compartmental JA biosynthesis, COI1/JAZ/MYC, hormone interaction, direct/indirect defenses, tolerance and genetics. Key source records checked: Toyota, Thines, Chini, Turlings, Strauss and Agrawal and volicitin work. Recomputed Nernst +118 mV; 87.5% assimilation; deltaF/F0 0.6; velocity 0.667 mm/s; steady-state JAZ 20→5; AD 50%, ECD 30%, ECI 30/45%; slopes −60/−16; enemy contrast 15 points; odor 71.43%. Illustrative datasets separated from published results. Reviewed 54 answer mappings.
review.editorial: Separate internal pass: 11 progressive teaching sections, 157 unique paragraphs, 11 labeled SVGs including revised layouts, 4 tables, 54 explained MCQs with balanced answers (14 A,14 B,13 C,13 D), 15 traps with causes and exam examples, 12 recall prompts and expanded revision. Zoom controls and existing reader/nav preserved. Static tag stack, JS parse, IDs and anchors passed.
